# Amazon MWAA

Store Apache Airflow environment configuration and tags without provisioning or running Airflow.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `mwaa` |
| Signing name | `airflow` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2020-07-01` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Configuration records only |
| Selected operations | 8 of 12 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-mwaa) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No Airflow execution, schedulers/workers/webserver, DAGs/tasks, provisioning, credentials, tokens, metrics/log delivery, lifecycle Status/LastUpdate or runtime URLs/queues/endpoints/readiness.
- No advanced artifacts, AirflowConfigurationOptions, logging, KMS, webserver access/scaling, maintenance or endpoint management; excluded fields reject even false/null/empty.
- Version and security-group mutations are unsupported, including combined CloudFormation rename; finite Regions/classes and explicit version are local boundaries.
- Reference checks do not verify route tables, private routing, ingress/egress, IAM trust/permissions, encryption or DAG contents; no existing DAG folder object is required.
- The [records guide](../guides/mwaa-records.md) lists all selected members/defaults/errors/update/tag/CF boundaries and an executable lifecycle; token and execution work remains [future scope](../roadmap/services/mwaa-runtime.md).

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

## Supported operations

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.

| Operation | HTTP binding |
| --- | --- |
| `CreateEnvironment` | `PUT /environments/{Name}` |
| `DeleteEnvironment` | `DELETE /environments/{Name}` |
| `GetEnvironment` | `GET /environments/{Name}` |
| `ListEnvironments` | `GET /environments` |
| `ListTagsForResource` | `GET /tags/{ResourceArn}` |
| `TagResource` | `POST /tags/{ResourceArn}` |
| `UntagResource` | `DELETE /tags/{ResourceArn}` |
| `UpdateEnvironment` | `PATCH /environments/{Name}` |
